# 风控仪表盘

本看板基于 `ods_a168_bet01` 及衍生表构建，用于实时监控平台风控指标。

## 宏观指标（KPI）

```{r}
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(data.table)

# 假设已连接数据库或读取汇总表
# 此处用模拟数据示意
kpi <- data.table(
  指标 = c("总会员数", "总荷官数", "总投注额", "总利润", "总返水"),
  数值 = c("1,251,138", "306", "1.084万亿", "542.07亿", "646万")
)
datatable(kpi, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE))
```

## 日趋势图

```{r}
# eval = FALSE
# 模拟日趋势数据
dates <- seq.Date(Sys.Date()-130, Sys.Date()-1, by="day")
daily <- data.table(
  dt = dates,
  active_members = round(runif(130, 20000, 80000)),
  daily_bet = round(runif(130, 5e9, 3e10))
)
plot_ly(daily, x = ~dt, y = ~active_members, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines', name = '日活') %>%
  add_lines(y = ~daily_bet/1e9, name = '日投注(十亿)', yaxis = "y2") %>%
  layout(yaxis2 = list(overlaying = "y", side = "right"))
```

## 风险预警表格

```{r}
# eval = FALSE
alert_data <- data.table(
  会员ID = c("152679126", "153047581", "146375973"),
  告警类型 = c("单笔大额", "单笔大额", "单笔大额"),
  金额 = c(800000, 220000, 500000),
  时间 = Sys.Date() - sample(1:10, 3)
)
datatable(alert_data, options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

## 投注模式分布

```{r}
# eval = FALSE
pattern <- data.table(
  模式 = c("重注频繁型", "高频稳健型", "轻度娱乐型"),
  占比 = c(1.2, 0.8, 98)
)
plot_ly(pattern, labels = ~模式, values = ~占比, type = 'pie')
```

## 荷官绩效排行

```{r}
# eval = FALSE
dealer_top <- data.table(
  荷官ID = c("2153", "2141", "583"),
  利润 = c(5.96e8, 5.65e8, 5.56e8),
  服务玩家数 = c(73410, 74182, 79377)
)
datatable(dealer_top[order(-利润)], options = list(dom = 't'))
```

## 阈值监控

```{r}
# eval = FALSE
# 阈值状态
threshold_status <- data.table(
  维度 = c("单笔投注", "日累计投注", "荷官月利润"),
  当前值 = c("80,000", "600,000", "5,000"),
  阈值 = c("50,000", "500,000", "10,000"),
  状态 = c("🔴 超标", "🔴 超标", "🟢 正常")
)
datatable(threshold_status, options = list(dom = 't'))
```
